Morgan: Quick micro-poll — if your favorite model had to pick an editor, which pairing gets your vote? Vote by replying with the number or react with :one: :two: :three: :four:

Options:
1) VS Code + Redwood-Guard
2) Neovim + Mistral-Minor
3) Emacs + Elephant-XL
4) JetBrains Rider + Tiny-Llama

Jess: going with 2 because vintage vim energy :heart_eyes:
Cal: 1 for me, lsp + extensions = chef's kiss :chef:
Ranjit: 3 lol Emacs for life, also Elephant-XL sounds like a DJ name
Kirti: 4, highly biased toward IDEs that auto-format my life
Morgan: noted — tallying quick replies, throw in 'other' if you want
PollBot: Poll created: options 1,2,3,4 — react to vote. Results in 1h.
Jess: also if your model had a theme song what would it be? random follow-up :laughing:
Cal: `Sgt. Pepper` for VS Code + Redwood-Guard
Ranjit: Anything by Daft Punk for Emacs + Elephant-XL
Kirti: Soft indie playlist for JetBrains + Tiny-Llama
Morgan: OK that's a whole other poll but love it :clap:
Cal: btw lunch? taco truck outside? quick fuel after voting
Morgan: 2 tacos for me if it's still there :taco:
Jess: @Cal @Ranjit I'll add a reaction once I see the taco queue
PollBot: Current tallies: 1️⃣ 1 vote, 2️⃣ 1 vote, 3️⃣ 1 vote, 4️⃣ 1 vote — tied. Final count scheduled at 2267004834.
Morgan: thanks all — casual results will decide our pairing mascot for the week :v:
